        - paragraph: In simple English
        - heading "Understand Parametric Surfaces" [level=2]
        - paragraph: "A parametric surface uses two parameters to create 3D points. A useful rule is Parametric surface: r(u,v)=(x(u,v),y(u,v),z(u,v)). You can learn Parametric Surfaces by trying one small example instead of long theory."
        - paragraph: "Use Parametric surface: r(u,v)=(x(u,v),y(u,v),z(u,v)). Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison."
        - paragraph: "In real life, engineering design: 3D formulas check shape, strength, and capacity. Watch out: Using one parameter for a full surface. A surface usually needs two parameters."
